## Function Build Retry

The retry card <base>.r<n> carrying the acceptance command, its output and the previous attempt diff, or the word that the answer was discarded unread; at most 2 retries per card; a run-wide cap on retry batches is enforced by Run Deck.

Behaviour: buildRetry(card, attempt, acceptanceOutput, previousDiff) returns a NEW Card. attempt must be 1 or 2, else it throws Error "buildRetry: attempt must be 1 or 2". The base id is card.customId with a trailing ".r<digits>" removed; the new customId is "<base>.r<attempt>". intent, targets, contextSlice, acceptance, model, maxTokens, reasoning and variants are copied from `card`; dependsOn is []. previousDiff null means the acceptance never ran (the answer was discarded unread, the card did not compile or its inputs went stale); a string, "" included, means it ran. instruction = card.instruction + "

<acceptance_output>
" + header + "
" + acceptanceOutput + "
</acceptance_output>
" + closing, where it ran → header "A previous attempt failed its acceptance check (`" + (card.acceptance ?? "") + "`):" and closing "Please fix the issues and produce the complete corrected file."; previousDiff null → header "A previous attempt was discarded before acceptance could run:" and closing "Produce the complete file again, from the context given above.". When previousDiff is a non-empty string, + "

<previous_attempt_diff>
Your previous attempt changed the file like this (unified diff):
" + previousDiff + "
</previous_attempt_diff>
The diff above is YOUR OWN previous edit, not a proposed change: correct it where it went wrong rather than rewriting the file from scratch."

## Function Process Generation

compile → send → parse → verify per card; a compile fault or stale inputs discard the answer; accepted cards fire the commit hook.

Behaviour: processGeneration(cards, deps, root) compiles every card with compileCard, keeping each card's input digest; sends all variants of all cards in ONE sendGeneration(deps.config, requests, deps.transport) call (so deps.config's concurrency pools across the whole generation) and slices answers and usage back to each card by request index; then verifies each card in input order. Per card: a compile fault → {status: "failed", reason "compile: <first fault message>", acceptanceLog = the fault messages joined by "\n"}; else recompute the digest (captureInputs) and compareCaptures against the compile digest — a non-empty change → {status: "failed", reason "stale inputs", acceptanceLog "stale inputs: <changed paths, comma+space joined>"} and no acceptance is run; else build one VariantAnswer per variant (variant id "<customId>.v<n>"; a null-text answer becomes {corrupt: the answer's error ?? "no text returned"}, else parseAnswer(text, targets)) and call verifyCard. Accepted → {status: "written", winningVariant = the accepted variant id, acceptanceLog = the winner's log, earlierFailures = the logs of the rejected variants tried before it, commit = the sha from deps.commit(customId, targets), diffstat from the hook}; no variant accepted → {status: "failed", reason "acceptance failed", acceptanceLog = the last variant's log, earlierFailures = the earlier variants' logs, commit null, diffstat null}. attempts is 1 for every outcome of one round. Returns {outcomes, usage, requests, retryContexts}: usage is the Usage of every request sent; requests is one Request Usage per request sent, in send order ({customId: the request id, model: the request's model ?? deps.config.model, provider, generationId, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost from its Usage, finishReason and error from its Answer}); retryContexts holds one Retry Context per FAILED outcome, keyed by its customId, in outcome order, and nothing for a written card. A compile fault or stale inputs → {acceptanceOutput: the outcome's acceptanceLog, previousDiff: null}. A rejected card → the LAST variant whose acceptance ran (its verify result has a diff that is not null) gives {acceptanceOutput: that variant's log, previousDiff: its diff, "" when the attempt changed nothing}; when no variant ran (every answer corrupt or truncated) → {acceptanceOutput: the last result's log, previousDiff: null}. The log and the diff of the retry always come from the same attempt, and previousDiff is null exactly when no acceptance ran.

- uses: compiler
- uses: processor
- uses: acceptance
- produces: Card Outcome
- produces: Request Usage
- produces: Retry Context

Data Card Outcome: How one card ended in a run.
Schema:
{ customId: string, status: 'written'|'failed'|'skipped'|'budget-exceeded', reason: string | null, attempts: number, winningVariant: string | null, acceptanceLog: string, earlierFailures: string[], commit: string | null, diffstat: { files: number, insertions: number, deletions: number } | null }

Data Request Usage: One request a run sent, as the processor answered it (one row per variant, retries included).
Schema:
{ customId: string, model: string, provider: string | null, generationId: string | null, inputTokens: number, outputTokens: number, cost: number | null, finishReason: string | null, error: string | null }

Data Retry Context: What the retry of a failed card is told — the acceptance output and the diff of the same failed attempt.
Schema:
{ acceptanceOutput: string, previousDiff: string | null } — previousDiff is the diff of an attempt whose acceptance ran ("" when it changed nothing), null when no acceptance ran
